answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 151110 Country: India Title: Is broiler chicken haram because some people say some kind of injections are used to grow it fast. And that injections are used of pork sperm. Please give me a fatwa regarding that. Question: Is broiler chicken haram because some people say some kind of injections are used to grow it fast. And that injections are used of pork sperm. Please give me a fatwa regarding that. Answer ID: 151110 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1179/1158/L=9/1438) It is not lawful to give such an injection to the chicken which contains pork sperm in order to grow them fast. However, if some chicken is injected with the injection then since the component becomes waste and extinct, thus it shall be lawful to eat such chicken. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
